title: Zay Flowers contract will cause plenty of ripple effects in the receiver market

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Zay Flowers contract will cause plenty of ripple effects in the receiver market
sources.description: When the Ravens rewarded receiver Zay Flowers with a new deal that carries a new-money average of $35 million per year, plenty of other receivers surely took notice.
